research_title: An Explainable Dynamic Graph Learning Framework for Adaptive Financial Fraud Detection under Concept Drift
evaluation_note: Sequential adaptation evaluation: earlier block labels are used only for later blocks. Do not describe the full sequence as an untouched heldout evaluation.
limitations: The current graph model is a learned historical aggregation prototype, not a complete dynamic temporal GNN.
The current adaptation schedule is block-based, not PSI-triggered.
Feature distribution changes alone do not establish concept drift.
Graph prototype validation performance is below the XGBoost baseline.
